experiment: hard-regime phase probe: multipath, calibration errors, interference
question: Does the learned E give a DOA benefit over untrained E and raw readouts under multipath, calibration errors and low SNR?

splits.environment_rule: disjoint fit/eval environment seeds; each source is assigned to one environment cyclically

geometry.note: nominal training geometry; not the measured field geometry

environment.paths: direct (amplitude 1.0) + 1-2 reflections (amplitude 0.2-0.8, random sign, delay 50 us - 5 ms, own angle |u|<=0.95)
environment.calibration: per-channel gain +/-0.5 dB, phase +/-0.05 rad, timing skew +/-0.1 us; fixed per environment
environment.interference: second source, own angle, SIR 0-10 dB relative to direct-path power; only mp_cal_int
environment.noise: independent AWGN per channel, variance from direct-path power and requested SNR

conditions.direct: single path, no calibration, no interference

readout.feature: per-bin cross product C x C (256 for E, 4 for raw)
readout.target_primary: geometric direct-path cross-phase before calibration (simulation truth)
readout.regression: ridge b.probe_fit, coefficient .01, fit on 8103, eval on 8102
readout.tdoa: grid search tau in [-130,130] us, step 0.25 us, parabolic refine
readout.u: OLS slope over pairs (i-j); k1 and k7 reported

primary_metric: median theta_deg from k7 on mp_cal at 10 dB, trained E
secondary_metrics: trained vs untrained vs raw per-bin
coverage, boundary fraction, per-bin phase error

decision_rule.representation_benefit: trained E >=20% better than untrained and raw per-bin on mp_cal (10 dB, then 0 dB) for >=2/3 seeds
decision_rule.no_benefit: trained approximately untrained; the representation hypothesis is not supported in this regime
decision_rule.readout_weak: trained better than untrained but >3x raw phase-slope; consider complex head / phase-consistency only with separate approval

stages.H1: direct, mp, cal, mp_cal at 10 dB
stages.H3: mp_cal_int at 10 and 0 dB, only if H1/H2 show an effect

checks: noiseless geometric-direct grid recovers tau to 0.05 us and u to 1e-6
direct 10 dB reproduces the previous phase probe within 0.15 deg
git status clean and validator PASS after run
limits: simplified static multipath; no Doppler, diffuse field or ice
calibration fixed per environment; applied in the STFT domain
4 fit + 4 eval environments; 3 seeds are repeated trainings
CPU float32; dev/probe only; test 8104 untouched
per-bin linear readout may be capacity-limited; failure limits the tested readout
diagnostic only; not an E gate, field result or DOA claim
